overview: The Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF) is a central sector scheme under the Prime Minister's AtmaNirbhar Bharat Abhiyan stimulus package of Rs.15000 crore. It incentivizes investments by individual entrepreneurs, private companies, MSME, Farmers Producers Organizations (FPOs), and Section 8 companies to establish infrastructure in dairy processing, meat processing, animal feed plants, breed improvement technology, animal waste to wealth management, and veterinary vaccine and drugs manufacturing facilities. The scheme provides loans up to 90% of project cost, 3% interest subvention, and credit guarantee cover for eligible entities.
objectives: To help increasing of milk and meat processing capacity and product diversification thereby providing greater access for unorganized rural milk and meat producers to organized milk and meat market
To make available increased price realization for the producer
To make available quality milk and meat products for the domestic consumer

To fulfill the objective of protein enriched quality food requirement of the growing population of the country and prevent malnutrition in one of the highest malnourished children population in the world
To promote exports and increase the export contribution in the milk and meat sector
To make available quality concentrated animals feed to the cattle, buffalo, sheep, goat, pig and poultry to provide balanced ration at affordable prices
eligibility: Following are the eligible entities for availing benefits under the AHIDF Scheme: a. Farmer Producer Organization (FPO) b. Private companies c. Individual entrepreneurs d. Section 8 companies e. Micro Small and Medium Enterprises
benefits: Loan up to 90% of project cost from Scheduled Banks or NCDC, 3% interest subvention provided by the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, credit guarantee cover up to 25% of loan amount from NABSanrakshan Trustee Co. Pvt. Ltd. for MSME units, and up to 85% guarantee cover for loan amount up to Rs. 2.0 crore from CGTMSE for micro and small enterprises. The interest subvention is released through the lending bank and is available for a maximum of 8 years from the date of first disbursement. Beneficiary contribution ranges from 10% for Micro and Small units, 15% for Medium Enterprises, and up to 25% for other categories of enterprises as per MSME defined ceilings.
financial_support: The project under the AHIDF shall be eligible for loan up to 90% of the estimated/actual project cost from any Scheduled Bank or National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC) based on submission of viable projects by eligible beneficiaries. There is no maximum or minimum limit of project cost or term loan. The beneficiary contribution in case of Micro and Small units as per MSME defined ceiling could be 10%, while in case of Medium Enterprises as per defined MSME ceiling, beneficiary contribution could go up to 15%. The beneficiary contribution in other categories of enterprises could go up to 25% or more. Interest subvention of 3% is provided to all eligible entities by the Department. The credit guarantee will be provided only for those projects which are viable and are covered under MSME defined ceilings and the guarantee coverage would be up to 25% of the credit facility available to the borrower. Eligible units may also avail credit guarantee cover from CGTMSE scheme for the loan amount up to Rs 2.00 crores with the guarantee cover of maximum extent of 85% of loan amount.
application_process: 1. Open https://ahidf.udyamimitra.in/ 2. Enter mobile number of Applicant. Select the checkbox of “I am not a Robot” and click on “Request OTP” button. 3. Enter 6 digits OTP received on Applicants mobile number and click on ‘Verify OTP’ button. Upon verification of OTP, User will be successfully on boarded. 4. Fill Applicant information, Promoters/ Management details and Project Information. 5. Validate all required fields on Fill Application tab and save/ Submit application. 6. On Successful submission on Application details, User will navigate to Upload Documents Page. On this screen user need to upload Project Documents and Documents related to Applicant/ Promoters. 7. Submit Application to marketplace or submit application to preferred lender. 8. Click on Submit to check Application Status and Application No. 9. View application status. Once application submitted, Application status become Logged. User can view application details or download application from this screen. In case of Application withdrawal click on Withdraw button so that application will get Withdraw and User need to apply again.
implementing_agency: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying

caveats: Interest subvention will not be allowed for the loan sanctioned for procurement of land, working capital, old machineries and vehicle for personal use.
The Eligible Entities will not be able to get the interest subvention if the Eligible Entities is defaulter of re-payment of loan amount in any given year.
Interest subvention will not be provided for the duration an account is NPA even if the beneficiary returns to standard category by the bank.
Interest subvention will be provided only up to 8 years of repayment period from the date of first disbursement. Beyond that no interest subvention will be provided.
Government entities and cooperatives are not eligible under AHIDF.
Farming loans are not eligible under the Scheme.
